name: topview
description: TopView Canvas for creating, organizing, and editing visual content with your Agent.

interface.shortDescription: TopView Canvas for creating, organizing, and editing visual content with your Agent.
interface.longDescription: TopView provides a shared visual Canvas for you and your Agent to create, organize, and refine visual content. Keep characters, scenes, references, assets, and versions connected, generate images and videos with built-in creative Skills, and switch naturally between Agent-driven creation and direct visual editing.
defaultPrompt: Analyze what makes this video work, then recreate it using my assets and creative direction.
Use my product assets to create 10 short-form video ad concepts for paid social.
Develop this story into a short drama, and organize the plot, characters, world, storyboards, and visual assets in Canvas.
